entries.en: Everybody stay calm out there. We're coming out. We're not armed.
Is it safe? Are they gone?
Nice going, Cole! I told you we should've stayed hidden.
It's okay. We're all on the same side here. We're just farmers. We've been hiding ever since that ship first showed up.
It showed up right before the attack. Knew it was trouble the second I saw it. So we made a break for the sheds.
You need something?
I was too busy running to get a clear look at it. I think it landed over near the spaceport.
Tell them about the noise, Cole. That awful noise.
It was emitting some kind of signal as it descended. Sounded like the shriek of the damned. Only it was coming from inside your own head.
The three of us were working the crops when that ship showed up. We just saw it and ran. I don't know what happened to the rest of the crew.
You don't know that! We survived. If they made it to the garage, they could've had a fighting chance!
We're just farmers. We heard they found something out there, but it never really mattered to us. Not until now.
Hey, Cole. We're just a bunch of farmers. These guys are soldiers. Maybe we should give them the stuff.
Geez, Blake. You gotta learn when to shut up!
Some guys at the spaceport were running a small smuggling ring. Nothing major. In exchange for a cut of the profits, we let them store packages in our sheds.
We're not hurting anybody! Hell, most of the time, I don't even know what's in the packages. I just thought there might be something we could use.
Good luck.
You're okay now. Nobody's going to hurt you.
Nobody moves a muscle until we know who you are!
We took care of them.
What else can you tell me about the ship you saw?
Tell me everything you remember about the attack.
Do you know anything about the Prothean beacon they dug up?
I have to go.
You have something to tell me, Cole?
You're breaking the law, Cole.
You greedy bastard! You weren't running for your life! You were running to check on your merchandise.
What kind of packages?
It's safe.
Stop right there!
They're gone.
Ship
Attack Details
Beacon
Goodbye.
What's going on?
Smuggling's a crime.
That's why you ran here!
Like what?
Those things were crawling all around the shed. They would have found us for sure. We owe you our lives.
I-- I still can't believe it. When we saw that ship I thought it was all over!
Whatever it was, felt like it was tearing right through my skull. Almost made it impossible to think.
They were by the garage. Over near the spaceport. Right where that ship came down. No way they survived.
No! It's not like that. I just... I just knew there were some packages here. Something we could use.
I found a pistol. Figured it would come in handy if those things came back. But you'll probably get more use out of it than we will.
Yeah, there's one more thing. I was going to sell it after this was over. But you probably deserve it more than I do.
Uh.... Oh, wait. I just remembered. I just had it in my pocket. Might as well take that, too. That's everything. Really.
Who's your contact at the spaceport, Cole? What's his name?
He's not a bad guy. I don't want to get him in trouble. Besides, I'm not a snitch!
Yeah, okay. You're right. His name's Powell. Works the docks at the spaceport. If he's still alive.
Powell! His name's Powell!
No honor among thieves.
That's all I know. Really. So let's try to keep things friendly from here on in, okay?
We're risking our lives to save this colony. You sure there's nothing else in here that could help us out?
I'm only going to ask this once. Think long and hard before you lie to me again. Are you sure all you've got is one lousy pistol?
He might have something to do with this whole attack, Cole. We need his name. It's important.
Would you rather be a snitch or a corpse?
This should help. Let's move out.
It was probably trying to block communications.
If there's something you're not telling me...
Was it a jamming signal?
You should come clean.
I don't like being lied to.
Is that all?
You're holding out on me!
Thanks.
He may know something.
Is he worth dying for?
Okay, forget about it. I've got more important things to worry about.
Fine.
Hand it over and I'll be on my way.
Give it to me.
We're just a small farming colony. Why did they attack us?
Those things would have killed us if you hadn't come along.
Look at Cole. How can he be so calm?
Look at all that smoke on the horizon. Must be coming from the spaceport.
I came here to get away from the stress of living on Earth. Ha!
I signed a three-year contract to work the farms, but I have had enough of this place.
Look at that smoke. Spaceport's probably ruined. It'll be weeks before I can leave this stupid colony!
First chance I get, I'm heading back to Earth. I don't care what Cole says!
What is that? Off in the distance.
It's a ship. Look at the size of it!
Something's moving! Over behind those crates!
Wait! Don't--Don't shoot! I'm one of you! I'm human.
I... I'm sorry. I was hiding. From those creatures.
Me? But... but I'm just a dockworker. I don't even have a weapon!
My name's Powell. I saw what happened to that turian. The other one shot him.
What are you doing sneaking around back there?
Sneaking up on us like that nearly got you killed!
I like the way you hid behind those crates during the fight. Really helped us out. Thanks a lot.
Who are you?
You need to be more careful.
You're a coward!
Commander. It's Nihlus.
A turian? You know him?
He's a Spectre. He was with us on the Nor--
He jumped on the cargo train and headed over to the other platform. Probably going after the beacon.
It's over on the other platform. Probably where that guy Saren was headed. He hopped on the cargo train right after he killed your friend.
I knew that beacon was trouble. Everything's gone to hell since we found it. First that damn mother ship showed up. Then the attack.
They killed everyone. Everyone! If I hadn't been behind the crates I'd be dead, too!
I've never seen anything like it before. It-- It was huge. Landed over near that platform. The whole place got dark as it came down.
It was quick. One minute, that ship was descending. The next, those geth were swarming over the platform, thousands of them.
Hard to believe that was only a few hours ago. Feels like a whole other life.
Take the cargo train. That's where the other turian went.
I... I can't stay here. I need to get away from all this.
Where'd Saren go after he killed Nihlus?
We were told a Prothean beacon was brought to the spaceport. What happened to it?
You're Cole's contact here on the docks. For the smuggling ring.
How come you're the only one who survived? Why didn't anyone else try to hide behind the crates?
Tell me about this 'mother ship' you saw.
Tell me about the geth attack.
Is there anything else you can tell me about the beacon?
We need to find that beacon before it's too late.
Then what?
What about the beacon?
Cole mentioned you.
The geth didn't find you?
Ship
Attack
Beacon
Let's go.
What? No! I mean.. what does it matter now? So I'm a smuggler? Who cares?
My supervisor's dead. The entire crew's dead. It doesn't matter now, does it?
A shipment of grenades came through last week. Nobody notices if a few small pieces go missing from the military orders.
You greedy son of a bitch! We're out here trying to protect your sorry ass and all you can think about is how you can rip us off?!
I never thought you'd actually need those grenades! Who'd want to attack Eden Prime? We're just a bunch of farmers! How was I supposed to know?
You're lucky the commander's here, Powell. Hand over those grenades.
They're yours. Take them. My smuggling days are over. I swear.
Yeah... this is a hell of a thing.
They never had a chance. I... I was already behind the crates when the attack started.
Wait a minute. You were hiding behind the crates before the attack?
And-- And it was making this noise, this-- this sound that bored right into your brain. That's what woke me up. The attack came a few minutes later.
I... sometimes I need a nap to get through my shift. I sneak off behind the crates to grab forty winks where the supervisor can't find me.
You survived because you're lazy?
I don't even have a gun! What was I supposed to do? Run out there and die?
I couldn't save them. Nobody could. It was... horrible.
Yeah. Yeah, I guess. I don't really want to think about it.
They must have been inside that mother ship. They shot anything that moved. It was a massacre.
Anything hidden nearby that we could use against the geth?
Forget about him. He's not worth it.
Hand over those grenades. Now!
Just give me the grenades.
We have more important things to worry about.
You were sleeping? I thought you were working here on the docks.
You ditch work. Then you cower back here and do nothing while the geth butcher everyone else!
If you hadn't snuck off for that nap you'd probably be dead just like all the others.
Smuggle any weapons?
You're right.
Let it go, Williams.
You're pathetic!
Hand them over.
Woke you up?
You make me sick.
Lucky break for you.
Yeah. Okay. There is something else I was saving. Could be worth a fortune. Experimental technology. Top of the line.
Okay! All right. There was something else. Could be worth a fortune. Experimental technology. Top of the line.
Take it. I don't need it. I didn't want anyone to get hurt. Really. I'm sorry.
Too many people died here for you to start jerking me around!
A lot of marines died here, Powell. Those grenades could have come in handy. If I were you, I'd think of some way to make it up to them.
You should make amends.
You're lying!
The geth didn't find you?
They brought it here this morning. We loaded it up onto the train and shipped it to the other platform.
There were two turians here. Your friend and another one he called Saren. I think they knew each other.
The other one got here first. He was waiting when your friend showed up. He called him Saren. I think they knew each other.
Your friend seemed to relax. He let his guard down... and Saren killed him. Shot him right in the back. I'm just lucky he didn't see me behind the crates.
I need to know how Nihlus died.
What the hell are you talking about?
You're saying Nihlus was murdered by a turian?
Tell me what happened.
Other one?
It wasn't the geth?
